After forfeiting his classical games against Bibisara in the semifinals, Magnus returned to face Vladislav Artemiev.
He finished the blitz section with a 3-1 score. However, in an interview with TV2, he said he would skip today's rapid section and play the classical games, which are must-win games for him!
Some interesting things are happening at Total Chess. What do you think about this situation?
